finite_frontier_theorem.name: V0_5_PROOF_SELECTOR_NO_RAW_CAP_RESCUE_REQUIRED_THROUGH_N54
finite_frontier_theorem.statement: Inherit N<=53. N54 hard roots still have r<=11. r<=8 is closed by the existing recurrence. r=9 introduces two possible degree-4 cells, closed by bounded m<=8 bridges. r=10 degree-3 roots use s<=49; the sole apparent m=12 dense danger is shown unreachable at high next-degree by the exact degree-4 balanced-survival literal transport lemma. r=11 degree-3 roots use fixed incidence/near-full bridges to n<=6. All required raw bounds remain below 54^2=2916.
